Disclaimer

Last Updated: January 1, 2025

1. Nature of Services

KolkataElderCare provides elder care coordination and telemedicine consultation services.

  • Care coordination between families and healthcare providers
  • Telemedicine video consultations with registered doctors
  • Gerontology assessments (non-medical care coordination)
  • Medicine schedule management and delivery coordination
  • Emergency response coordination

2. Not a Substitute for Emergency Care

In case of a medical emergency, always call 108 (ambulance) or go to the nearest hospital immediately. Our service is NOT a substitute for emergency medical care.

3. Medical Disclaimer

  • Telemedicine consultations are advisory in nature
  • Our doctors provide their best medical judgment but cannot perform physical examinations remotely
  • Prescriptions issued via telemedicine follow Telemedicine Practice Guidelines of India (2020)
  • Some conditions require in-person examination
  • Always follow up with in-person care when recommended

4. Gerontology Services

Our CMIG-certified gerontology services are non-medical care coordination. Gerontologists provide:

  • Home safety assessments
  • Social and emotional well-being monitoring
  • Coordination with medical professionals
  • Activity and lifestyle recommendations

Gerontologists do NOT diagnose, prescribe medicines, or provide medical treatment.

5. Credentials

  • All doctors are MCI/NMC registered with verified registration numbers
  • Gerontologists are CMIG Kolkata certified
  • License: WB-TELEMED-2024
  • ABDM Integrated
  • KMC Trade License: Applied
  • GST: Not applicable (below threshold)

6. Limitation of Liability

KolkataElderCare shall not be liable for:

  • Outcomes of medical treatments prescribed by consulting doctors
  • Delays caused by patient non-compliance with recommendations
  • Third-party service failures (pharmacy delays, hospital wait times)
  • Network or technology failures during telemedicine consultations

7. Third-Party Services

We coordinate with third-party providers but do not control their services. We are not liable for their performance, pricing, or availability.

8. Testimonials

Testimonials represent individual experiences. Results may vary.
